sentences.text: Daniel Dewan Sewell -LRB- born March 16 , 1981 -RRB- , better known by his stage name Danny Brown , is an American rapper from Detroit , Michigan .	Detroit	Detroit	Michigan	Michigan	stage name	stage name
He is best known for his individuality , being described by MTV as `` one of rap 's most unique figures in recent memory '' .	MTV	MTV
In 2010 , after amassing several mixtapes , Brown released his debut studio album , The Hybrid .	The Hybrid	The Hybrid (album)

Brown began to gain major recognition after the release of his second studio album , XXX , which received critical acclaim and earned him such accolades as Spin , as well as Metro Times `` Artist of the Year '' .	XXX	XXX (Danny Brown album)	Spin	Spin (magazine)	Metro Times	Metro Times
